change_log.change: CFO approved revenue metrics; CAC, LTV, GM marked not calculable

metrics.currency_handling: USD only. Currency codes normalised for case only; non-ISO codes excluded and reported
metrics.timezone_handling: UTC; period boundaries at 00:00 UTC on the 1st of the month
metrics.name: Monthly recurring revenue
metrics.business_definition: Recurring subscription revenue normalised to one month, for subscriptions active at month end
metrics.formula: sum(subscriptions.mrr_amount) where start_date <= period_end and (end_date is null or end_date > period_end)
metrics.time_period: calendar month, measured at month end
known_limitations: mrr_amount: confirm whether net of discounts
S010 and S011 excluded pending fixes (800 USD)

metrics.currency_handling: USD only. Currency codes normalised for case only; non-ISO codes excluded and reported
metrics.timezone_handling: UTC; period boundaries at 00:00 UTC on the 1st of the month
metrics.name: Annual recurring revenue
metrics.formula: mrr x 12 at the same month end

metrics.currency_handling: USD only. Currency codes normalised for case only; non-ISO codes excluded and reported
metrics.timezone_handling: UTC; period boundaries at 00:00 UTC on the 1st of the month
metrics.name: MRR growth
metrics.business_definition: Relative change in MRR between two month ends

metrics.currency_handling: USD only. Currency codes normalised for case only; non-ISO codes excluded and reported
metrics.timezone_handling: UTC; period boundaries at 00:00 UTC on the 1st of the month
metrics.name: Net revenue retention
metrics.business_definition: MRR retained from customers active at the start date, including expansion
metrics.formula: cohort_mrr(end) / cohort_mrr(start); cohort = customers with MRR > 0 at start
metrics.time_period: Jan-Jun 2026 (5-month window); 12-month standard not yet possible
known_limitations: window shorter than 12 months: do not compare with 12-month benchmarks
customer entities must be de-duplicated first

metrics.currency_handling: USD only. Currency codes normalised for case only; non-ISO codes excluded and reported
metrics.timezone_handling: UTC; period boundaries at 00:00 UTC on the 1st of the month
metrics.name: Gross revenue retention

metrics.currency_handling: USD only. Currency codes normalised for case only; non-ISO codes excluded and reported
metrics.timezone_handling: UTC; period boundaries at 00:00 UTC on the 1st of the month
metrics.name: Customer churn
metrics.business_definition: Share of start-cohort customers with no MRR at the end date
known_limitations: 2 churn events only: no comparison between groups at more than Low confidence

metrics.currency_handling: USD only. Currency codes normalised for case only; non-ISO codes excluded and reported
metrics.timezone_handling: UTC; period boundaries at 00:00 UTC on the 1st of the month
metrics.name: Gross revenue churn
metrics.business_definition: Contraction plus churned MRR over start MRR

metrics.currency_handling: USD only. Currency codes normalised for case only; non-ISO codes excluded and reported
metrics.timezone_handling: UTC; period boundaries at 00:00 UTC on the 1st of the month
metrics.name: Average revenue per account
metrics.business_definition: MRR divided by paying customer entities
metrics.formula: mrr / count(distinct customer entities with mrr > 0)

metrics.currency_handling: USD only. Currency codes normalised for case only; non-ISO codes excluded and reported
metrics.timezone_handling: UTC; period boundaries at 00:00 UTC on the 1st of the month
metrics.name: Customer concentration
metrics.business_definition: Share of MRR from the largest and the top-3 customers

metrics.currency_handling: USD only. Currency codes normalised for case only; non-ISO codes excluded and reported
metrics.timezone_handling: UTC; period boundaries at 00:00 UTC on the 1st of the month
metrics.name: Gross margin
metrics.business_definition: Revenue less cost of revenue, over revenue
metrics.not_calculable_reason: No cost-of-revenue data (only infrastructure cost). Use OPS-2 infrastructure cost ratio instead; do not label it gross margin

metrics.currency_handling: USD only. Currency codes normalised for case only; non-ISO codes excluded and reported
metrics.timezone_handling: UTC; period boundaries at 00:00 UTC on the 1st of the month
metrics.name: Customer acquisition cost
metrics.business_definition: Sales and marketing spend per new customer
metrics.not_calculable_reason: No sales and marketing spend data. Do not approximate from headcount

metrics.currency_handling: USD only. Currency codes normalised for case only; non-ISO codes excluded and reported
metrics.timezone_handling: UTC; period boundaries at 00:00 UTC on the 1st of the month
metrics.name: Customer lifetime value
metrics.business_definition: Expected gross profit per customer over its lifetime
metrics.not_calculable_reason: Gross margin unavailable; churn history under 12 months and fewer than 30 churn events

metrics.currency_handling: USD only. Currency codes normalised for case only; non-ISO codes excluded and reported
metrics.timezone_handling: UTC; period boundaries at 00:00 UTC on the 1st of the month
metrics.name: User activation rate
metrics.business_definition: Share of new users who create a report within 14 days of user creation
metrics.formula: count(users with report_created within 14 days of created_at) / count(cohort users); cohort = users whose 14-day window lies inside event coverage

metrics.currency_handling: USD only. Currency codes normalised for case only; non-ISO codes excluded and reported
metrics.timezone_handling: UTC; period boundaries at 00:00 UTC on the 1st of the month
metrics.name: Feature adoption (account level)
metrics.business_definition: Share of paying accounts using a feature at least once in the month
metrics.formula: count(paying accounts with >= 1 feature event) / count(paying accounts)

metrics.currency_handling: USD only. Currency codes normalised for case only; non-ISO codes excluded and reported
metrics.timezone_handling: UTC; period boundaries at 00:00 UTC on the 1st of the month
metrics.name: Support burden
metrics.business_definition: Tickets per paying account after resolving customer references
metrics.formula: count(tickets resolved to entity) / count(paying entities)
known_limitations: customer_ref formats inconsistent: normalisation rule required
